name: BinDawood Holding Company
summary: BinDawood Holding Company operates hypermarkets and supermarkets in Qatar, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides loyalty management; information technology and communication; delivery, storage and transportation services; warehouse storage management and rental; and market influencing and digital marketing services.
